catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.logicalSeriesDescription: Group two or more series from the same library under one title. Their files, volumes and progress will be preserved.
catalog.logicalSeriesOrderHelp: Assign a unique position to each series. Volumes retain their order within each one.
catalog.logicalSeriesInvalid: Enter a title and select at least two series with unique positive integer positions.
catalog.logicalSeriesUnavailable: Could not create the logical series. Refresh the page and check that the series are still available.
catalog.logicalSeriesDeleteSure: Only the grouping will be removed. Physical series will appear separately again and keep their files and progress.
